newsitem.title: USA: NIMO restarts 1,137 MW NY nuke unit.
newsitem.headline: NIMO restarts 1,137 MW NY nuke unit.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp (NIMO) began restart of the 1,137 megawatt (MW) Nine Mile Point 2 nuclear unit after shutting it September 28 for refueling, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The reactor was running at less than one percent of capacity, NRC said Friday in its daily status report.
The nearby 610 megawatt (MW) Nine Mile Point unit 1 was operating at full output, the NRC said.
The Nine Mile Point units are in Scriba, N.Y., and are both operated by NIMO. NIMO has sole ownership of unit 1 and 41 percent interest in unit 2.

Other owners of Nine Mile Point unit 2 includes New York State Electric and Gas Co (18 percent), Long Island Lighting Co (18 percent), Rochester Gas and Electric Co (14 percent) and Central Hudson Gas and Electric Co (nine percent).
